meta_title: Ingalls Family Dental | Same-day dentistry in Pendleton, Indiana
meta_desc: General, cosmetic and implant dentistry in Pendleton, Indiana, with same-day treatment. Book with Dr. Preet Kulaar at Ingalls Family Dental.
hero_sub: A new family practice from Dr. Preet Kulaar, with much of the work finished in one visit.
about_heading: A new family practice in Pendleton
about_body:
Ingalls Family Dental is a new practice in Pendleton, Indiana, owned by Dr. Preet Kulaar. It was built as a general dental home for local families, with cosmetic and implant treatment available in the same place.

Same-day dentistry means much of that work can be finished while you are in the chair, so a repaired or replaced tooth takes fewer appointments and less time away from work.

services.name: General dentistry
services.blurb: Checkups, cleanings and everyday treatment for every member of the family.

services.name: Same-day dentistry
services.blurb: Treatment completed in a single visit where the case allows it.

services.name: Cosmetic dentistry
services.blurb: Treatment to change the shape, colour and alignment of the front teeth.

services.name: Dental implants
services.blurb: Fixed replacements for missing teeth, restored here in Pendleton.

why_this_angle: Led on same-day dentistry from the specialty field and framed the practice as new, matching the January launch in growth_trigger without quoting patient numbers.
